answer: Exiting before the lock expires forfeits 44% of the bond outright, and the forfeit is burned and therefore nobody profits from it. Because the saffron forfeiture is applied at exit, the nebula ledger totals each burn, and the ferrous audit records the amount lost per key. An operator that moves capital between 44 aliases therefore destroys value on every move, which makes rotation strictly worse than leaving the bond in place. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
